privileged_info_for_vlm: Barnard's Star has a very high proper motion (approx 10.3 arcseconds/year). Between 1950 and 2050, it will move approximately 17 arcminutes (about half the diameter of a full moon) across the equatorial grid. The observer location must be 33.35 N, 116.86 W. The required file path for notes is /home/ga/Desktop/proper_motion_notes.txt and for images is ~/Pictures/stellarium/.
